hardware: Creality K2 Pro CFS cfs0_050_G32 / cfs0_000_153
temperature_control: nozzle/bed targets 0 C; no heating requested

rfid_state_after_unload.note: Retained RFID slot 1 no longer blocks writes even though RFID diagnostic's legacy 'busy' shorthand is true.

unload.interpretation: Moonraker request queued/delayed; it executed only once box returned to IDLE, so it does not demonstrate a moving-time acceptance or rejection. Harmless ID18 value was restored.

moving_protection.safety_caveat: During early physical feeding, box.state/state_code can still be IDLE/0 while box.operation.active=true. The stock CFS BOX_STATE byte alone is not proven sufficient as an independent MCU-side movement guard. Host guard rejected the active-load request. Direct MCU protocol bypass was intentionally not tested.

remaining_release_gate: Verify/strengthen independent MCU physical movement predicate beyond BOX_STATE=IDLE because live feeding can be underway while BOX_STATE remains IDLE.
Test MCU-side rejection under active load/unload without circumventing Kalico host interlocks or introducing unsafe writes.
Repeat cycles under more varied conditions and verify RFID background work and unexpected/unknown states.
Do not merge the experimental firmware or host PR as production ready until safety gate is satisfied.
